messages:
Maya (Sales): Quick heads-up — Sam from NovaRetail is asking for a POC quote that includes HIPAA + 7yr audit log retention + HSM-backed keys. They want pricing before next week's exec review.
Sam (Customer): Hi Maya — can you confirm whether the POC can ship with HSM and full audit log retention? Need a ballpark for monthly cost at ~100M tokens/month during POC.
Maya (Sales): @Claudia (Security) do we have a standard line-item for 'HSM keywrap + audit logs (7yr)' or is this custom? Also any SOC2/HIPAA language to attach?
Claudia (Security): We have a compliance add-on template but 7yr retention is atypical — default is 1yr archive. 7yr requires cold storage + extra ingestion/encryption controls. Need deal desk sign-off.
Raj (Eng): Technically we can enable HSM (KMIP/HSM integration) for the private control plane in the POC. Performance hit is small for token throughput, but cost is ~+15% on infra and adds export controls.
Olive (Deal Desk): For pricing path: we can do a short-term POC add-on surcharge or roll it into a committed reserved capacity. For a 1mo POC at 100M tokens, quick estimate: base hosted cost + HSM premium + long-retention storage. Need exact base rate.
Maya (Sales): Base rate for that customer is our standard hosted ratecard — current list: `0.0006 / prompt token, 0.0012 / completion token`. Can someone help compute a POC line?
Raj (Eng): Assuming 50/50 prompt/completion split at 100M tokens -> cost tokens = 100M * ((0.0006+0.0012)/2) = ~90k USD token cost. HSM infra premium + engineering around 15k for the month. 7yr retention cold storage estimate ~4k (S3 Glacier style). Add our compliance add-on margin (25%).
Olive (Deal Desk): Quick calc (ballpark): token cost 90k + infra premium 15k + storage 4k = 109k. Add 25% compliance margin = 136.25k. For POC we can offer a capped uplift to US$120k if legal accepts short-term agreement.
Claudia (Security): Legal will need to sign the HIPAA BA + a scope for audit log storage location and access controls. Also confirm customer wants vendor-managed KMS or customer-managed HSM (they mentioned HSM).
Sam (Customer): They want customer-managed HSM (hardware we control). HIPAA BA required. If possible, can we get a temp discount for POC?
Maya (Sales): Requesting deal desk approval for a POC cap of $120k with customer-managed HSM and 7yr retention. @Olive can you route? I will attach scope notes.
Olive (Deal Desk): Filed D-REQ-7421 with requested cap $120k, retention exception, and C-M HSM. Will route to pricing committee and legal. ETA 48 hours.
dealbot: Deal Desk request D-REQ-7421 created by Olive. Status: pending -> pricing-committee.
Raj (Eng): Heads-up: if they insist on customer-managed HSM in a hosted offering we need network/VPC config and an engineering runbook. That adds ~3 engineer-days.
Claudia (Security): Also prepare special audit export tooling — 7yr retention needs immutability and export APIs. We should note in the SOW that long-tail exports will be charged separately.
Olive (Deal Desk): Noted. I'll request the 3 eng-day estimate as a separate line item and flag the export charge. Sending to pricing committee now.
Maya (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll loop Sam in once we have D-REQ response. Sam, I'll try to push the exec timeline if pricing takes longer. :thumbsup:
Sam (Customer): Appreciate it. If you can get the $120k cap and BA signed, we can start next Monday.
Olive (Deal Desk): Pricing committee asked for explicit confirmation: is the POC 30 days? And are we ok with a non-refundable setup fee? Please reply.
Maya (Sales): Yes — 30 days POC. Prefer refundable but will accept $10k non-refundable setup fee if necessary.
Claudia (Security): I'll prep the HIPAA BA draft and list the additional SOW sections for HSM + retention. Expect a draft in 48 hours.
Olive (Deal Desk): Update: pricing committee provisionally approves $120k cap + $10k setup fee; legal must confirm BA. Marking D-REQ-7421 as 'provisionally approved'.
Maya (Sales): Great — thanks. Keeping thread open for legal docs.
Sam (Customer): Perfect, thanks all.
